Michael Phelps holds the record for the most Olympic gold medals of any individual athlete, with 23 gold medals won across four Olympic Games from 2004 to 2016 [d6]. No other Olympian has won more than 9 gold medals in total [d1], and Phelps's 23 golds are more than double the count of his nearest rivals [d8]. Among women, former Soviet gymnast Larisa Latynina held the record for most gold medals by a female athlete with 9, a mark that was tied by Katie Ledecky at the 2024 Paris Olympics [d4][d5]. Phelps also set the record for most gold medals in a single Olympic Games, winning 8 golds at the 2008 Beijing Olympics [d2][d3].
